objective: Bake avatar graphics on GPU once; animate arbitrary unseen speech locally from the baked package without an image-generation neural network at runtime
requirements: Executable offline graphics-baking algorithm, run on user's own GPU pod
Portable avatar package with graphical states, coverage metadata and transitions
Independent CPU runtime with no CUDA, PyTorch image model or network requirement
New Russian speech not used to build the state library
Temporal continuity, moving head/background and explicit silence/interruption handling
Measured quality loss against an unquantized teacher, CPU speed, memory and package size
Runnable demo, tests and reproducible instructions; honest limits on realism
baseline: Run 05 uses supplied eight mouth sprites or live DH neural rendering. Neither is the requested full baking cycle.
hypothesis: A pose-conditioned graphical atlas plus temporally coherent state selection can replace live neural image synthesis at lower runtime cost
primary: Lip-region reconstruction error against held-out teacher renders, plus human inspection of side-by-side video
data_split: Separate Russian calibration corpus and held-out phrases. Codebook and temporal penalties frozen before evaluation.
stop_rule: Do not call completed until baking and independent CPU playback both run, unseen speech is evaluated, and the original goal passes an explicit audit

cost.gpu: User authorized own existing pod; H100 discovered running and idle; no resource scaling

asset_policy: Public research/demo material or synthetic character; preserve attribution/watermarks; do not publish a demo face as a commercially cleared identity
